description: Verify that DUT-emitted ARP Probe inter-frame intervals fall within [PROBE_MIN-50 ms, PROBE_MAX+50 ms] (RFC 3927 §2.2.1)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 3927 §2.2.1 says consecutive Probes are spaced randomly between PROBE_MIN (1 s) and PROBE_MAX (2 s). The harness allows ±50 ms tolerance to absorb scheduler jitter. Out-of-range intervals indicate a buggy timer (too slow → claim takes too long; too fast → conflict detection windows are smaller than the spec assumed).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine, no fast envelope)

2. Observation (probing window):
   • DUT → wire: 3 ARP Probes
     - Δt(probe[k+1] - probe[k]) ∈ [PROBE_MIN - 50 ms, PROBE_MAX + 50 ms]   ← key check

[Pass condition]
All 3 Probes emitted AND every consecutive Δt is inside the bound.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_probes — DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline
• Fail_too_few_probes — fewer than 3 Probes within the deadline
• Fail_interval_out_of_range — at least one inter-Probe interval is outside the RFC 3927 bounds

verdicts.Pass: Probe intervals are inside [PROBE_MIN-50 ms, PROBE_MAX+50 ms] — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_probes: DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline
verdicts.Fail_too_few_probes: Fewer than 3 ARP Probes within the deadline
verdicts.Fail_interval_out_of_range: Probe interval is outside the RFC 3927 bounds
